lessons_used: Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful and won (+5.2%), though evidence remains thin with only one test.
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for most other specific categories (adoption/new_screen, choose_path changes, finish/redesign, home/hint, sign_in/copy), as each has only one test.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all tests.
Reordering sign-in was significantly underpredicted (+1.0% predicted vs +5.2% after noise correction).

candidates.title: Defer Account Sign In to Final Step
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen to the very end of onboarding right before final launch, allowing users to customize and adopt their pet before authenticating.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in previously yielded a +5.2% gain when placed after selection; moving it even later removes upfront friction before user investment.

candidates.title: Redesign Photo Upload Screen Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a clean split-column layout featuring a helpful visual mascot guide alongside photo pickers.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with mean completion taking over 1000s, indicating photo upload confusion and high drop-off.

upload_photos.headline: Bring Your Pet to Life
upload_photos.body: Upload clear photos of your pet from different angles to create your custom desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the layout of the photo upload screen while preserving its function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but redesigns have historically yielded negative relative lifts.

candidates.change: Add a dedicated controls cheat sheet screen before completion to explain desktop pet shortcut keys and hidden toolbar controls.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup, alongside a 35.2% finish step drop-off.
